infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: STRIKE uses your position to draw the fishing route, tag contacts and catches, and warn you about protected zones — also while the phone is in your pocket during a trip you started.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: STRIKE uses your camera to take catch and profile photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: STRIKE lets you attach catch photos to your trip log.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: STRIKE saves your catch photos to your photo library when you share a trip card.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: STRIKE only tracks your position during a fishing trip you start yourself. It never tracks you outside a trip.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: STRIKE only tracks your position during a fishing trip you start yourself. It never tracks you outside a trip.
